questions.stem_text: The terms 'crisis of the 1970 s' is used to refer to:

options.B: the eradication of the welfare state
options.C: rising divorce rates and the decline of the traditional family
options.D: an unfortunate twist in fashion sensibility

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - declining profits and rising unemployment

questions.stem_text:
Sullivan's (2000) study suggested that the proportion of housework men did was greatest
when:

options.A: they had rediscovered themselves as 'new men'
options.B: their wives were at home and nagged them all the time
options.C: exciting gadgets like the hoover and electric iron were invented
options.D: they were unemployed or both partners worked full time

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - they were unemployed or both partners worked full time

questions.stem_text: One of the difficulties in 'operationalizing' concepts like social class is that:

options.A: definitions and indicators can vary, making valid comparisons problematic
options.B: there are no reliable indicators of such widely contested ideas
options.C: it takes all the fun out of armchair theorising
options.D: it has little use for applied, empirical research about the topic

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - definitions and indicators can vary, making valid comparisons problematic

questions.stem_text: In idealized views of science, the experimental method is said to involve:

options.A: testing out new research methods to see which one works best
options.B: isolating and measuring the effect of one variable upon another
options.C: using personal beliefs and values to decide what to study
options.D: interpreting data subjectively, drawing on theoretical paradigms

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - isolating and measuring the effect of one variable upon another

questions.stem_text: White-collar crime is low in visibility because:

options.A: it involves only small amounts of money
options.B: the proletariat can outsmart the bourgeoisie
options.C: the police turn a blind eye to corporate crime
options.D: it goes undetected in the context of everyday business transactions

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - it goes undetected in the context of everyday business transactions
